connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Read and manage repositories, issues, pull requests and workflow runs on GitHub.

secrets.name: GITHUB_MCP_AUTH
secrets.what: The word Bearer, a space, then a GitHub personal access token

connectors.setup: Create a fine-grained personal access token, then store `Bearer <your token>` as the secret GITHUB_MCP_AUTH.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as io.github.github/github-mcp-server 2.0.1 with streamable-http remote https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ and a secret Authorization header

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.description: Read channels, threads and messages in a Slack workspace and search conversation history.

secrets.name: SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN
secrets.what: A Slack user OAuth token (starts with xoxp-)

connectors.setup: Create a Slack app, add the user scopes you need, install it to your workspace and copy the User OAuth Token. Posting messages stays off unless you also set SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL.
connectors.verified: npm package slack-mcp-server exists, latest 1.3.0, not deprecated (replaces the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack); README documents SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.description: Search, read and create files in Google Drive.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.what: OAuth client ID of a Google Cloud desktop app

secrets.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.what: OAuth client secret of the same app

connectors.setup: Needs a Google sign-in in a browser the first time it runs, so it only works in the local edition. Add `gmail calendar docs sheets` after `drive` for more Google apps.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as io.github.taylorwilsdon/workspace-mcp 2.0.1 (pypi workspace-mcp); PyPI has 2.0.1, not yanked; README documents GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and --tools

connectors.name: Postgres
connectors.description: Explore schemas, run read-only SQL and get index and query-tuning advice on a PostgreSQL database.
connectors.setup: Restricted mode only allows read-only queries; change it to --access-mode=unrestricted to allow writes.
connectors.verified: PyPI package postgres-mcp exists, latest 0.3.0, not yanked (replaces the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres); README documents DATABASE_URI and --access-mode

connectors.name: Browser (Playwright)
connectors.description: Drive a real web browser to open pages, click, type, fill forms and take snapshots.
connectors.setup: On your own machine the first run may need `npx playwright install chromium`. In the sandbox the browser image has Chromium; list the sites it may open in the project's egress list.
connectors.verified: npm @playwright/mcp latest 0.0.83, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as io.github.microsoft/playwright-mcp (replaces the archived server-puppeteer)

connectors.name: Fetch
connectors.description: Download a web page and turn it into clean Markdown the agent can read.
connectors.verified: PyPI package mcp-server-fetch exists, latest 2026.8.18, not yanked

connectors.name: Brave Search
connectors.description: Search the web, news, images and videos with the Brave Search API.
connectors.verified: npm @brave/brave-search-mcp-server latest 2.1.4, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as io.github.brave/brave-search-mcp-server with required secret BRAVE_API_KEY (replaces the archived server-brave-search)

connectors.name: Exa Search
connectors.description: Search the web and fetch page contents with Exa, tuned for research and code questions.
connectors.setup: Works without a key at a limited rate. For higher limits add a header `Authorization` holding the secret `Bearer <your Exa API key>`.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as ai.exa/exa 3.4.1 with streamable-http remote https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp and no required headers; npm exa-mcp-server 3.4.2 README says the hosted server works anonymously with rate limits

connectors.name: Tavily Search
connectors.description: Search the web and extract, crawl and map websites with Tavily.

secrets.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
secrets.what: A Tavily API key (starts with tvly-)

connectors.verified: npm tavily-mcp latest 0.2.22, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as io.github.tavily-ai/tavily-mcp with required secret TAVILY_API_KEY

connectors.name: Filesystem
connectors.description: Read, write, move and search files inside the folders you allow.
connectors.setup: Replace `.` with the folder(s) the agent may use; it cannot reach anything outside them.
connectors.verified: npm @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem latest 2026.8.31, not deprecated

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.description: Search, read, create and update Notion pages and databases.

secrets.name: NOTION_TOKEN
secrets.what: A Notion internal integration secret (starts with ntn_)

connectors.setup: Create an internal integration, copy its secret, then share the pages the agent may use with that integration.
connectors.verified: npm @notionhq/notion-mcp-server latest 2.5.2, not deprecated; README documents NOTION_TOKEN. (Notion's hosted server com.notion/mcp in the registry needs OAuth.)

connectors.name: Linear
connectors.description: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments.
connectors.setup: Select the connector and click Connect to sign in to Linear with your own account. Runs that you start use your connection; for schedules, webhooks and deployments an admin connects a service account and the connector is set to act as the service connection.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as app.linear/linear 1.0.1 with streamable-http remote https://mcp.linear.app/mcp and no header auth

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.description: Look up Sentry errors, issues, events and releases to help debug production problems.
connectors.verified: npm @sentry/mcp-server latest 0.42.0, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as io.github.getsentry/sentry-mcp with required secret SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.description: Work with Stripe customers, products, prices, invoices, payment links and refunds.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.what: A Stripe restricted API key (rk_...) with only the permissions the agent needs

connectors.setup: Use a restricted key: its permissions decide which tools work. Start with a test-mode key.
connectors.verified: npm @stripe/mcp latest 0.3.3, not deprecated; README documents STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. (Stripe's hosted com.stripe/mcp in the registry lists no header auth.)

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.description: Query tables, inspect schemas, read logs and manage Supabase projects.
connectors.setup: Runs read-only; remove --read-only to allow changes. Add `--project-ref=<ref>` to limit it to one project.
connectors.verified: npm @supabase/mcp-server-supabase latest 0.13.0, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as com.supabase/mcp with required secret SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN

connectors.name: MongoDB
connectors.description: Browse MongoDB databases and collections, run queries and aggregations and inspect indexes.
connectors.setup: Runs read-only; remove --readOnly to allow writes.
connectors.verified: npm mongodb-mcp-server latest 3.0.5, not deprecated; listed in the MCP registry as io.github.mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server with secret MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING; 3.0.5 README documents --readOnly

connectors.name: Atlassian (Jira & Confluence)

connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as com.atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server 2.0.0 with streamable-http remote https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp and no header auth

connectors.name: Context7
connectors.description: Pull current, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.
connectors.setup: Works without a key. For higher limits add a header `Authorization` holding the secret `Bearer <your Context7 API key>`.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as io.github.upstash/context7 4.1.3 with streamable-http remote https://mcp.context7.com/mcp and an optional Authorization header; README says the key is optional

connectors.name: Firecrawl
connectors.description: Scrape, crawl and search websites and get clean Markdown or structured data back.

secrets.name: FIRECRAWL_MCP_AUTH
secrets.what: The word Bearer, a space, then a Firecrawl API key (fc-...)

connectors.setup: Store `Bearer <your Firecrawl API key>` as the secret FIRECRAWL_MCP_AUTH.
connectors.verified: Listed in the MCP registry as io.github.firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server 3.28.2 with streamable-http remote https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp and an Authorization header; README shows `Authorization: Bearer <FIRECRAWL_API_KEY>`
